title: introduce-credential-fallback-queue-and-typed-pushpull-stream-facade
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: TypeScript SDK v1.7.0: add credential fallback queue to reduce stream churn on transient auth failures; introduce typed PushPullStream facade with pause/resume and backpressure hints; minor tests and docs.
body:
Summary: This PR adds a lightweight credential fallback queue and a typed PushPull stream facade to the TypeScript SDK to improve streaming ergonomics across intermittent auth errors and to provide clearer backpressure signals for consumers. Motivation: real-world usage shows that transient auth failures (rotating tokens, short-lived KMS calls) cause noisy stream restarts that are hard to coordinate across consumer code. The credential fallback queue defers token refresh attempts, serializes credential handoffs, and exposes a compact retry policy hook. The PushPull stream facade provides a single ergonomic primitive for both push-based chunks from the server and pull-based iteration from the client with typed events and pause/resume hints.

Commits: 1) Add CredentialQueue dispatcher and tests; 2) Implement TypedPushPullStream facade + docs; 3) Wire credential queue into session manager and stream connector; 4) Add integration tests simulating token rollover; 5) Update package.json version to 1.7.0 and changelog.

Files changed (high level): src/credentials/credentialQueue.ts, src/stream/pushPullFacade.ts, src/stream/events.ts (new typed events), src/session/sessionConnector.ts, src/index.ts (export), test/credentials/*, test/stream/*, package.json, CHANGELOG.md

Checklist: - [x] API design review with SDK owners - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Backward compat smoke test against python/go SDKs (local) - [x] Docs snippet in README streams section

Review thread: Reviewer Sofia Patel requested narrowing the public surface: removed the TokenBroker public class and exported only the queue factory (author: Maya Chen) and updated tests; Reviewer Ethan Blake asked for deterministic timeouts for the integration test, addressed by introducing fake timers in tests; Nikos Stavros suggested adding backpressure hint enums — implemented as StreamBackpressureHint in events.ts. CI initially failed lint (prettier) and a flaky test; lint fixed, flaky test stabilized after increasing retry window; final CI green. Approvals: Sofia (approve), Ethan (approve + comment), Nikos (approve)

Merge: Squash-merged into main by Maya Chen on 2026-03-03. Rollout note: v1.7.0 published to npm; downstream TypeScript consumers can opt-in by swapping their StreamConnector import; Python/Go SDK teams were pinged and a follow-up cross-repo PR in the redwood monorepo will wire the new credential queue into the runtime connector (linked).

Related: Linked Linear: ENG-2145, ENG-2201. Support ticket SUP-5487 documented a customer incident that motivated the change.
